Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.register

Class ModDataComponentTypes

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.register.ModDataComponentTypes
public final class ModDataComponentTypes extends Object
The DataComponentTypes that carry every bucket family's persistent per-stack state. Runtime bucket behavior accesses these components through BucketState; loader registration code enters the instances into Registries.DATA_COMPONENT_TYPE, and data-driven item construction may write a component directly.

FLUID_CONTENT, MILK_AMOUNT, POWDER_UNITS, and CAPTURED_MOBS are the mutually exclusive content group a bucket write clears before selecting one; JUNK_CONTENTS is independent and coexists with any of them.
